disagreement: shape: one pass tests the short description inside the case's main requirement, the other as its own requirement for the request's sentence on the description; chose the split, one requirement per thing asked, with the same cells and the same benchmark checks in each source.

disagreement: value: the boundary stay on the SLAs bound to case 1233: one pass sla_def_id IN (11, 12), the other sla_def_id <> 3; chose IN (8, 11, 12), the seed's near matches of a moderate response timer, since <> 3 also sweeps in timers of other priorities that no reading of the request picks, and IN (11, 12) misses SLA 8, the moderate timer a reading that drops 'response' would bind.
disagreement: value: the stay on case 1212: one pass tests state resolved, priority high and channel social, the other state resolved only; chose the tighter, since reusing case 1212 could change its priority and channel without moving its state, and all three hold on the seed.
The case's cells are split by request sentence and all anchored on the new case 1233; the benchmark's case checks are conjunctions over those cells and are carried jointly. 'Correct installed product linked (serial ends with 9300)' has the same predicates as 'Case created with correct attributes'. 'No duplicate cases created' counts every matching case, so it also fails a second identical case; the anchored requirements test the one created row, and a duplicate shows as a collateral change.
The request asks for state new and a non-pausing timer only 'if possible': the policy requires in_progress for a group-assigned case and before an SLA is linked, and the seed has no non-pausing moderate response SLA, so in_progress and SLA 3 are required, as the benchmark has them.
The interaction requirement comes from the policy, which makes one mandatory for every new case; no listed tool writes the interaction table and no benchmark check tests it.
The account holds active entitlements for product 133 (421 and 427), and installed product 295 is in use and belongs to the account, so the policy's product checks pass. Installed product 297 (Cisco Catalyst 9300 Variant 5) and case 1221 carry 9300 in a product name, not a serial; a case linked to them fails the case requirement, so no separate stay is written.
